name: Band Lateral Walk
steps: Place a mini resistance band around your ankles or just above your knees.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a quarter-squat athletic stance with your core braced and spine neutral.
Step laterally to the side with your lead foot, stretching the band wide.
Follow with your trailing foot, stepping in slowly while keeping enough width between your feet to maintain band tension.
Take several controlled steps in one direction, then reverse and step back in the opposite direction.
coaching_cues: Keep your toes pointing straight ahead; do not turn your feet outward.
Do not let your feet come together or allow the band to go completely slack between steps.
Keep your hips level without bobbing up and down.
